title: Research Intern @ Functional Nanomaterials & Devices Lab
description: Research Intern at Functional Nanomaterials & Devices Lab (https://www.nanomatlab.in/) focused on walnut biomass valorization, processing techniques, modifications, applications, etc
body:
Undergraduate Biotechnology student at the Central University of Kashmir with a keen interest in nanobiotechnology, molecular biology, and computational tools.
Laboratory research focusing on walnut biomass valorization, processing techniques, and foundational computational workflows.  
Deeply committed to honing practical experimental skill sets, exploring emerging technologies, and contributing to innovative multidisciplinary research that bridges nanoscience and biotechnology.
